item.description:
• Scans now spot and name Sennheiser, Blackmagic and QLab devices
  • Each device in scan results lists every protocol it speaks
  • Scans and IP changes are noticeably faster
  • Scan results name the real maker, and mark devices hiding behind a randomised address
  • Scan results window now auto sizes columns and remembers your layout
  • Join Subnet shows the exact address it will take before you confirm
  • Get a notification if any of your adapter names are reset
  • Service Order highlights the service you came from and marks hidden services
  • Renaming services and locations, and deleting services, act on exactly the one you picked and no longer ask for Touch ID
  • Quicker IP asks for your admin password once after this update, then goes back to working silently
  • Fixed the Public IP line disappearing while the menu is open, and rows with nothing to report now sit empty instead of showing a dash
  • Network Info no longer disappears on inactive adapters

• Collapsed adapters now show their preset and IP on a second line (Turn the summary line off in Settings if you prefer plain rows)
  • Every adapter shows its interface name (en), lined up on the right
  • Long names and text now auto scroll when you hover on them
  • Drag presets into the order you want
  • More Info is now Network Info, and sits below Preset and Scan
  • Network Info adds IGMP Query, Audio Clock, Grandmaster and Clock Sync
  • Clear the error counters, and see how long each has been counting
  • Quicker IP warns you before putting an address on an adapter that already has one
  • General layout, wording and colour improvements across the menu

• Collapsed adapters now show their live IP address on the header row, so you can read every adapter's address without expanding anything
  • A header IP only appears when the adapter actually has a live address, so an IP on a collapsed row is always real; expand or hover an adapter to see a configured static that isn't live
  • Collapsed adapter headers now show the active preset name next to the Wi-Fi network name
  • The interface name is hidden while an adapter is collapsed and still appears in More Info and the hover menu
  • Public IP, IP, Subnet, Gateway, DNS, More Info, Preset and Scan now line up on one column, in the menu and in the hover menus
  • Tighter, more even spacing in each adapter's section, with a single small break between the address rows and Preset and Scan
  • Icons now appear only on items that open something outside the menu, so the rest of the menu reads as one clean column; Settings keeps its gear
  • The Settings row now sizes itself to suit whether the info panel is showing
  • The speed test hover menu now shows the Loaded result, matching the results window
  • Updated the built-in manufacturer list so scan results name recently released hardware

• Closing and reopening the lid no longer fires false Disconnected / Connected notifications; alerts settle briefly after wake and only fire if the network actually changed
  • Applying a Manual IP or Subnet Hop no longer fires false Disconnected / Connected notifications while the adapter re-binds
  • Speed test results in the menu now show a dash like the results window when latency can't be measured
  • Fixed a cancelled speed test being able to leave one download stream briefly running in the background
  • Fixed a rare crash risk when a network command timed out mid-read

• Fixed the LAN scan missing Dante and other UDP-advertised devices: device names, Dante type badges and orange other-subnet rows now appear on a real Dante network
  • Fixed a rare crash on Macs left running for weeks (CPU meter tick counter overflow)
  • Fixed the menu-bar speed readout showing huge false spikes once an adapter passed 4 GB of traffic
  • Fixed the wrong device being acted on when right-clicking a scan result while a rescan finished
  • Fixed a rescan re-triggered right after cancelling doubling up the network discovery
  • Packet Loss monitor now supports IPv6 targets instead of reporting 100% loss
  • Save Preset now warns before replacing an existing preset of the same name
  • Speed Test shows a dash instead of a misleading "0 ms" green ping when latency can't be measured
  • Fixed a rare hang if the network helper became unresponsive; the helper now also works on macOS 14.6 through 15.6
  • Menu opens faster: network locations now load in the background instead of briefly blocking the menu
  • Scan results window now clears when you clear results, and its Rescan button syncs when you switch adapters
  • Fixed the update window opening behind other windows when installing an update. The update into this version may still do it once, since your current version controls that step - click the Quicker IP dock icon to bring it forward if so; fixed for all updates after this

• More Info details (IPv6, Wi-Fi signal, link stats) now update live while the menu's open
  • Fixed a settings window memory leak
  • Fixed a speed test ping/jitter glitch
  • Fixed rescan button in the scan results window

• Per-adapter DNS: Automatic, Cloudflare, Google, Quad9, or custom servers
  • New Packet Loss monitor (Pro): live dropped-ping timeline with CSV export
  • Speed Test now grades bufferbloat (loaded latency during the test)
  • Smarter LAN scan: subnet-mask aware, scoped to the adapter you scan, and finds mDNS devices on that wire including link-local or static gear (Dante etc.) stranded on another subnet that other tools hide
  • Scan results now show device names and the network protocol (Dante, NDI, AirPlay, printer and more) instead of raw hostnames and service strings; hover a row for the technical hostname
  • Ping now shows the target's name (reverse DNS / Bonjour) next to the IP when one is found
  • Join Subnet: right-click an out-of-subnet device to hop your adapter onto its network
  • Warns when an adapter's gateway is outside its own subnet and cannot be reached
  • Flags a duplicate IP: a red marker on the IP row of any two adapters sharing the same address, now also explained in More Info
  • Scan results: popup title now updates to the adapter you just scanned (previously kept the prior scan's name)
  • Option-click any adapter's chevron to collapse or expand every adapter at once
  • Plus smaller fixes: per-adapter ping routing, expanded adapters persist, menu dropdown holds a steady width, long preset names truncate instead of stretching the menu, the scan results window updates to the adapter and range the moment a scan starts, plus security and stability hardening
